name: billion-context-release-notes
description: Tiered, model-written release notes for billion-context. Read-only companion payload consumed by the proxy's #1870 visibility watcher; version number is bumped by CI on every publish (the field itself is meaningless).

releases.summary: Window & preflight accuracy wave: dsh context windows resolve again after every resolveModelInfo call failed on a detached receiver (#1943); preflight no longer fires at 59–63% real usage — local estimates are now calibrated against provider-reported usage (#1940, #1933); pi virtual-model selections no longer double-compress (#1962); re-signed SDK-HMAC-SHA256 egress on armed tunnels (#1884).
OpenCode WebSocket traffic is intercepted again — compression and usage stats no longer silently no-op on OpenCode ≥ 2.0.20 (#1844).

Compression is now inherited across agent restart / resume / new-branch forks (#1834): folded summaries survive instead of silently re-expanding on the wire (claude-code and openai-chat wires; codex/gemini in #1853 follow-up).
dsh installs self-heal: profile bundles now converge to the global version automatically (#1803/#1804) — fixes the one-time 'invalid plugin' boot crash after a new bili publish.
dsh: stale landing page after restart fixed (#1787); no-op for other hosts.

Stability wave: zero-injection session identity keeps the prefix cache hot across fork/resume (#1692/#1611); launcher port hardening (#1756); ACP tag-echo strip no longer eats prose (#1722); responses degenerate-output guard and transport replay retry.
